# Lumen Design System

> Warp's design system for freight logistics SaaS. Dark-first, operator-density,
> Spring Green (#00FA8A) on obsidian (#0D0D0D), Satoshi typeface, dual-mode
> (restrained | expressive), LLM-first MD-driven, DTCG 2025.10 tokens, shadcn
> registry. v0.13.0 — Phase 0 (DTCG foundation) + Phase 1 (expressive mode +
> ModeScope) + Phase 2 (component library → shadcn registry under `@lumen/*`) +
> Phase 3 (platform translation guides + six reference apps) shipped. 48
> components in the registry plus 69 legacy v0.12.6 sidecars (121 total
> registry items). Foundation: `@lumen/lumen-base` installs the whole system in
> one command. Per-platform guides at `/design-system/04-platforms/` cover iOS,
> Android, macOS, Windows, Shopify, browser extension, CLI (Go + Node), MCP
> server, responsive web. v0.12.6 token names and component contracts preserved
> verbatim — additive, never destructive.

This file is the agent-readable index. Fetch one section at a time; each section
points to specific MD or JSON files that an agent can load to resolve a query.
Do NOT load the whole repo as context — load the master briefing, the AGENTS
digest, then the specific foundation / token / component files relevant to the
task.

## Tokens — DTCG 2025.10 (primitives → semantic → modes → components)

### Primitives

- [Radius](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/radius.tokens.json) — 9 stops xs through 4xl + full
- [Typography](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/typography.tokens.json) — Satoshi family / weight / size / leading / tracking + OpenType features + code.fallback

## Components — shadcn registry under `@lumen/*` (121 items; v0.13 Phase 2)

Registry endpoint: `https://warp-lumen-design-guidelines.vercel.app/r/{name}.json`
Consumer install: `npx shadcn add @lumen/<name>` from any project (after `components.json` is configured per the [shadcn 4 docs](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/registry)).
Single-payload install: `npx shadcn add @lumen/lumen-base` brings tokens + font + ModeScope + utils in one command.

### Foundation registries (REG tier)
- [lumen-base](/public/r/lumen-base.json) — `registry:base` single-payload installer (the whole system in one command)
- [font-satoshi](/public/r/font-satoshi.json) — `registry:lib` self-hosted Satoshi Variable + Italic (ITF-FFL)
- [tokens](/public/r/tokens.json) — `registry:style` DTCG 2025.10 token graph (CSS variables)
- [utils](/public/r/utils.json) — `registry:lib` cn() class-merger
- [mode-scope](/public/r/mode-scope.json) — Phase 1 ModeScope primitive

### Tier 1 — Primitives (20 items)
button · input · textarea · card · sheet · popover · tooltip · toast · badge · tag · avatar · skeleton · spinner · tabs · breadcrumb · switch · checkbox · radio · slider · progress

data-table (TanStack-virtualized) · command-palette (cmdk) · drawer · modal · dropdown-menu · combobox · calendar (react-day-picker) · date-picker · filter-builder · filter-chip · saved-view · sidebar · top-bar · pagination · select

### Tier 3 — Lumen signatures (3 items — preserved v0.12.4 behavior verbatim)
stat · live-dot · rate-ticker

### Legacy v0.12.6 sidecars (69 items — preserved during the v0.13 migration window)
accordion · action-sheet · ai-badge · ai-prompt-input · ai-suggestion · alert · banner · bottom-nav · breadcrumbs (alias of breadcrumb) · button-group · carousel · cart-drawer · chart · chat-bubble · citation-card · coach-mark · code-block · color-picker · command-palette-button · comment-thread · copy-button · data-grid · dialog · divider · empty-state · fab · field · file-dropzone · form · icon-button · inventory-status · kanban · kbd · kpi-card · link · list · logo-cloud · navbar · notification-center · number-input · otp-input · panel · password-input · permission-prompt · phone-frame · presence-indicator · pricing-card · pull-to-refresh · radio-group (alias of radio) · range-slider · reaction-bar · search-field · segmented · snackbar · sparkline · split-button · status-bar · stepper · swipe-action · table · tags-input · testimonial-card · time-picker · timeline · toggle · toolbar · tree-view · trend · validation-message

Per-component LLM contract (v0.13 shape — every registry item):
- `02-components/<name>/<name>.md` — frontmatter + prose + anatomy + do/don't + code
- `02-components/<name>/<name>.skill.md` — Vercel-format SKILL.md with NEVER rules verbatim
- `02-components/<name>/<name>.tsx` — canonical React implementation (token-driven, mode-agnostic, zero hex literals)
- `02-components/<name>/<name>.test.tsx` — Vitest + @testing-library/react smoke + behavior tests
- `02-components/<name>/<name>.stories.tsx` — Storybook 10.3 CSF Factory format (Component Manifest auto-emitted)
- `02-components/<name>/<name>.registry.json` — shadcn registry-item.json
- `02-components/<name>/manifest.json` — Storybook 10.3 Component Manifest entry

## Prompt library — gpt-image-2 (v0.13 Phase 4 — `/design-system/05-prompts/`)

The paste-ready prompt system for Lumen-branded imagery. One immutable style anchor, seven per-asset templates, a CLI that assembles them, and a reference asset set under `/examples/gpt-image-2/`. See [`05-prompts/README.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/README.md).

### Anchor + templates (8 files)

- [`style-anchor.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/style-anchor.md) — the **immovable** master prompt (verbatim from master doc §9; do not edit in place, version-bump instead)
- [`hero-background.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/hero-background.md) — landing-page hero backgrounds · 16:9 · 2560×1440 · expressive
- [`abstract-shape.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/abstract-shape.md) — empty-state covers, secondary heroes, loading screens · 1:1 · 1600×1600 · restrained
- [`illustration.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/illustration.md) — onboarding step illustrations, feature heroes · 1:1 or 16:9 · expressive
- [`pattern.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/pattern.md) — seamless tile patterns · 1:1 · 512×512 · restrained
- [`mesh.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/mesh.md) — five Phase 1 mesh-recipe visual references (`aurora-spring`, `aurora-cool`, `dock-bay`, `lane-arc`, `cross-dock`) · 16:9 · 2560×1440 · expressive
- [`empty-state.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/empty-state.md) — dashboard empty states · 1:1 or 4:3 · restrained · **anticipatory** mood
- [`marketing-card.md`](/design-system/05-prompts/marketing-card.md) — OG cards, social shares, blog heroes, landing-page feature blocks · 1.91:1 or 16:9 · expressive

### CLI

- Path: [`tools/lumen-prompts/`](/tools/lumen-prompts/) — `pnpm prompts <template> --subject "..."` emits the fully-assembled prompt; `pnpm prompts:generate-references` (operator-side, requires `OPENAI_API_KEY`) materializes the reference PNGs.
- Icon rejection: the CLI refuses `icon`, `icons`, `iconography`, `glyph`, `symbol` — Lumen icons are hand-drawn vectors, never gpt-image-2 output.

### Reference assets

- Path: [`examples/gpt-image-2/`](/examples/gpt-image-2/) — one `canonical-subject.md` manifest per template (in repo) + one PNG per template (operator-materializes; not committed by default to avoid silent snapshot drift). Mesh ships 5 PNGs (one per recipe).

### Model pin

- Snapshot: `gpt-image-2-2026-04-21` — pinned in every template and the anchor.
- Drift policy: per master doc §11, the `gpt-image-2` alias may roll forward silently. Re-baseline by updating the pin in one PR, regenerating the entire reference set, and committing as a versioned bump.

## MCP (Phase 6 lands — `/design-system/07-mcp/`)

- Install: `claude mcp add --transport http lumen https://lumen.warp.dev/mcp`
- Tools: `list_components`, `get_component`, `get_tokens`, `search`, `install`, `get_prompt_template`
- shadcn consumer config: [`components.json`](/components.json) (root)
- shadcn registry manifest: [`registry.json`](/registry.json) (root, Phase 2 fills)

## Hard rules (must follow — see AGENTS.md for the full prose)

1. Never invent tokens. Always reference semantic, never primitives.
2. Every component ships `component.json` + (Phase 2) `<name>.skill.md`.
3. WCAG 2.2 AA hard floor. `prefers-reduced-motion` + `prefers-reduced-transparency` honored.
4. Spring Green (`#00FA8A`) is the only loud color. Action / live / success only. Never decorative.
5. White on accent surface ≈ 1.4:1 — AA fail. Use `color.accent.fg` (`#07120D`) or `.lumen-btn-*` defensive classes.
6. Floating UI portals to `document.body`. Never inline `<div absolute>`.
7. Focus rings ride `outline + box-shadow`, never box-shadow alone.
8. Position math via inline `style`, not Tailwind arbitrary classes.
9. Version labels import from `lib/version.ts`, never hardcoded literals.
10. `<details>`/`<summary>` accordions with custom chevron get `class="lumen-summary"`.
11. v0.13 — Mode is a scope attribute, never a per-component prop.
12. v0.13 — `backdrop-filter` only on floating shells (popover, sheet, command palette, nav, hero device frame). NEVER on canvas, data table, row, cell.
13. v0.13 — DTCG 2025.10. `$value` + `$type` + `$description` on every token. Alias syntax `{token.path}`. No hex literals outside primitives.
14. v0.13 — Phase 0 alias namespace (`color.obsidian/spring/lumen-red/lumen-amber`) is first-class but additive. v0.12.6 names preserved verbatim.
15. v0.13 — Vercel AI Elements naming for AI primitives (Conversation, Message, Reasoning, Tool, Sources, InlineCitation, PromptInput, Suggestion, Confirmation, Artifact, WebPreview, Agent). Anthropic Citations API JSON shape for citation UI.
16. v0.13 — gpt-image-2 generates atmosphere, NEVER icons. Snapshot-pin `gpt-image-2-2026-04-21` in every prompt. Open every prompt with `@import 05-prompts/style-anchor.md`.

## Operating context

- Repo: github.com/NeelMyno/Warp-Lumen-Design-Guidelines
- Live preview: https://warp-lumen-design-guidelines.vercel.app
- Build: `pnpm tokens` → `dist/` (v0.13; was `_build/` pre-v0.13)
- Audit: `pnpm audit:contrast` → `tools/audit-baseline/contrast-{restrained,expressive}.json`
- Version: see `/VERSION` (currently `0.13.0`) and `/audit-dashboard/src/lib/version.ts`
